text:
morgan: FYI customer hit a bunch of 413s on /v1/embeddings after the console "soft-quota" popover went live. They sent mixed-dim array (512 + 1536) in one request.

sujeet: Can you paste a repro payload or a minimal trace? Is this failing on ingress because of per-shard byte caps or some runtime check?

morgan: Repro in staging attached: 120 vectors total, ~4.2MB body. Routing chose shard-B which has max_payload_bytes=2MB and returned 413.

eli: Current behavior: routing uses primary-dim hint header to pick shard. Splitter only auto-splits for uniform dims unless client opts into byte-based split. So mixed dims commonly slip through and then hit payload caps.

roxanne: UX problem: console shows a suggestion hint when the preflight estimator thinks a split would help, but it doesn't surface for mixed dims. So customers get a suggestion sometimes but still see 413s. Confusing.

morgan: Minimal log:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-Dims: 1536,512,512,1536,...
Body: [ [..vectors..] ] (~4.2MB)
Response: 413 Payload Too Large
Routing: shard-B (max_payload_bytes=2097152)
Splitter: noop (mixed dims, byte-split disabled)
```

sujeet: Proposal: 1) Emit a lightweight preflight decision event when a request likely exceeds shard limits; 2) Return a split suggestion header from preflight; 3) Console shows copyable curl + "Try split" CTA even for mixed dims.

eli: From runtime side we can add `Prefer: prefer_auto_split=true` header that will cause ingress to auto-retry client-side with a dim-aware split strategy. Needs idempotency token and conservative retry/backoff. Preflight cost ~1-3ms.

roxanne: Console copy note: don't scare customers about cost. Show cost comparison (packed vs split) and success probability. Example: "Packed success: 40% on your region. Split into 2: success ~99%. Estimated cost: packed $0.042, split (2x) $0.045".

morgan: API suggestion: preflight header `X-Split-Suggestion: suggested=[{"parts":"2","strategy":"dim-aware"}]`. Clients can use `?split=2&strategy=dim-aware` or send `Prefer: prefer_auto_split=true`. If auto-split fails, we surface original 413.

sujeet: Implementation notes: preflight must not transmit vector payloads to telemetry. Only emit dims counts and total_bytes. Metrics: preflight.suggested, route.reject.413, split.retry.success.

eli: Telemetry plan: add events `preflight.split_suggestion` (tenant, suggested_parts, total_bytes, max_shard_bytes), `ingress.413` (tenant, shard), and `console.split_click` (tenant, suggested_parts). Dashboards: per-tenant 413 rate, split adoption %, avg latency delta. Add alert: tenant 413 rate > 0.5% of embeddings traffic.

roxanne: I'll mock up the console flows: (A) Inline preflight badge with suggested split and copyable curl, (B) Action button "Auto-split and retry" (only enabled when `Prefer` header supported), (C) Small explainer about mixed dims and routing.

morgan: Next steps: @sujeet prototype preflight + header, @eli implement telemetry/events + alert, @roxanne produce mockups and support guide. I'll coordinate canary. Target: start 20% canary next week.

api-deploy-bot: Canary rollout: preflight-split-suggestion enabled for 20% of eng-platform traffic at 2026-03-20T15:12Z.

morgan: Also create a short support doc with reproduction steps and recommended troubleshooting: example curl to split, console screenshots, and how to enable `Prefer`.

roxanne: Will do. I'll keep wording friendly and actionable.

sujeet: One more thing: ensure our splitter respects ordering for users who depend on vector order. Document that split requests preserve original order across parts.

eli: Good call. Auto-split responses should include `X-Original-Order-Preserved: true` header and an idempotency token.

morgan: Great. Meeting notes captured. Thanks team :thumbsup:
